findings.message: 2 large-set statement(s) run past 3 lines at 1440px: "“Our washer stopped draining on a Sunday…" → 5 lines at 28.8px; "“No guessing, no pressure. I knew the di…" → 4 lines at 28.8px
findings.fix: A statement set large is about 30 words. Cut it, or set the rest as ordinary body text.
Remove unless it is a real drop zone.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "Choose the appliance that needs attentio" 4.1:1 needs 4.5:1; "One short request keeps the important de" 4.1:1 needs 4.5:1; "Choose an appliance and the issue you ca" 4.1:1 needs 4.5:1; "We confirm your ZIP, timing and the visi" 4.1:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (4.6:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: 1 display line(s) start inside the margin but run off the right edge by a few pixels: "SUPER MASTER" (28px)
findings.fix: Fit the line to the content box by measurement (a small fit script, or SVG text with textLength), or bleed it on purpose by a clear amount from the margin. A name sliced by a few pixels on one side reads as a mistake.
